units.source_text: 背后传来女人的一声尖叫。

en.t: A woman's scream came from behind him.

units.source_text: 男人拼出全身的力气，把铁锹猛地扎了过去。

en.t: The man summoned all the strength in his body and drove the shovel hard into it.

units.source_text: 铁锹轻而易举地穿透了板壁。

en.t: The shovel pierced the plank wall with effortless ease.

units.source_text: 它脆得简直像回潮了的饼干。

en.t: It was so brittle that it was almost like a damp cracker.

units.source_text: 那些让沙子清洗过，外表看起来还很新的板材，其实都已经开始腐烂了。

en.t: The planks, washed by the sand and still looking fairly new on the outside, had in fact already begun to rot.
